Renee Wallace: Heads-up 1: final onsiter Imani B is traveling in today. Interview window 6:00pm-8:00pm. Need arrival plan and quiet hotel for one night.
Omar Diaz: ETA? flying or train?
Renee Wallace: flight UA 324 lands EWR 3:40pm, expects to clear customs/arrivals by ~4:10. Could also take NJ Transit then Lyft, but prefers we arrange pickup.
Kai L.: we can pre-book town car from the airport. corporate limit $75. Approve?
Ben Ortiz: approve up to $90 for pickup if needed. Otherwise rideshare voucher ok.
Reception: After-hours arrival protocol: enter via South Lobby, bring photo ID, call desk at +1-555-303-4444 for access. We'll have a printed badge.
Renee Wallace: thanks. Can someone meet them in lobby at 5:00pm?
Omar Diaz: I can meet at 5:05 and escort to interview room. Adding meetup to calendar.
People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted for Imani Brown. Badge ETA: 15 minutes post check-in. After-hours door code will be shared with attendees only.
Renee Wallace: hotel preference: Cedar House (quiet, business floors). rate $199/night corporate. Any objections?
Kai L.: booked Cedar House on corporate card. Confirmation posted to calendar with folio link.
Ben Ortiz: note candidate dietary: vegan + serious tree nut allergy. Kitchen to prep nut-free boxed meal.
Reception: When Imani arrives please text "Imani B - arrived" to +1-555-303-4444 and we'll expedite badge printing.
Renee Wallace: travel reimbursement: please forward any ride receipts to finance@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Travel - Imani Brown - [date]" and cc me. We reimburse within 5 business days.
Omar Diaz: panel, do we want a remote dial-in backup? Zoom link reserved in the invite if needed.
Ben Ortiz: panel confirmed; backup only if delay >30m.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: Create an expense ticket if vendor car used. Template: "Expense Type: Candidate Transport; Amount: $XX; Candidate: Imani Brown; Approver: Ben Ortiz".
Renee Wallace: assigning pickup: Omar will meet. I'll DM Imani the lobby instructions and the Reception number. :white_check_mark:
Reception: We'll place a visitor parking hangtag at the desk if they drive. Let us know plate.
Kai L.: added itinerary to calendar, voucher link sent to candidate.
Renee Wallace: closing the loop 1: anything else, post here.
People Ops Bot: This thread will be archived after 7 days per channel retention settings.
